messages:
anya: Quick check — planning to flip a small canary for spec-decoding + flash-attn changes tomorrow morning. Want to confirm rollout window and guardrails. :eyes:
jyoti: +1 from infra side. what % for canary?
sam: suggest 2% users (~10 instances) for 30m ramp, then 10% for 1h if stable. auto rollback on 3xx/5xx spike or +20% latency regression.
devon: Need to know exact flag names so SRE can patch alerting. Also confirm model families affected (gptx-small, gptx-medium).
anya: flags: `runtime.toggle.spec_decoding=true`, `runtime.kernel.flash_attn=opt_v3`, `runtime.kv.prefetch=true`. rollout config I plan to use: 
```yaml
canary:
  stages:
    - pct: 2
      duration: 30m
    - pct: 10
      duration: 60m
guardrails:
  max_p95_latency_increase_pct: 15
  max_error_rate_increase_pct: 1.5
  token_quality_drop_pct: 2
models: [gptx-small, gptx-medium]
```
jyoti: ok for infra. one ops note: opt_v3 needs kernel fallback path to opt_v2 on OOM. pls add `fallback=opt_v2` in the rollout meta.
sam: will add alerts: `runtime.latency.p95` (alert if > baseline*1.15 for 5m), `runtime.errors.rate` (alert if > baseline+1.5% sustained 3m), and the token-quality monitor hook.
devon: patching the canary runbook now. can we include a quick smoke that checks KV hits after prefetch flip? simple curl to a test route should hit cache: `curl -H "x-test-user: canary" https://api/redwood/runtime/test-kv-hit`
anya: yes — adding that as pre-promote gate. also adding a manual hold at 2% to validate logs.
ops-bot: deployment-scheduler: Canary window reserved for 2028-03-12 09:00-11:00 UTC. Notifying on-call.
jyoti: note about capacity: flash_attn opt_v3 increases ephemeral memory by ~10% on medium GPUs — autoscaler should allow +2 nodes if needed. i've set a soft-cap override.
sam: thanks. devon, can you post a PR for the rollout manifest and include the fallback config? aim to merge tonight.
devon: on it. will tag @sam and @anya for review. PR will include a tiny benchmark report for opt_v2 vs opt_v3 (latency median/p95 + memory).
anya: last check — any objections to enabling structured logging for canary only? would help debugging but verbose.
jyoti: do it for canary only, make sure retention is 7d and scrub sensitive fields.
sam: agree. plus add a quick eval prompt set to track hallucination regressions (automated evaler).
devon: PR up: `github.com/redwood/runtime/pulls/8123`. includes rollback playbook and smoke steps.
anya: perfect. thanks everyone. I'll kick off the scheduler tomorrow and ping when we start. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: alert: on-call rotated to `sam` at 2028-03-12 08:55 UTC.
sam: got it, will be watching the dashboards.
anya: end.
